title: Early music, Baltimore pianists, Peabody, and first pro trio in 1936
summary: Ewell gives his birth details, early piccolo and piano lessons, his brother's records, Waller and Morton records and collector Bill Riddle, then a short trio tour to Atlantic City and business college.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
